Am 16.5.1959 fand auf dem Tempelhofer Feld in Westberlin eine grosse Truppenparade der USA-Besatzungstruppen statt, ausserdem fand in einigen USA-Kasernen ein Tag "offener Türen" statt.

images.caption: I began my trip by arriving in Berlin at Tempelhof airport.  It had snowed the night before.  Tempelhof was the main airport used in the Berlin Airlift in 1948–1949.  It was closed in 2008.  The television tower in East Berlin is in the left background.
images.alt: I began my trip by arriving in Berlin at Tempelhof airport.  It had snowed the night before.  Tempelhof was the main airport used in the Berlin Airlift in 1948–1949.  It was closed in 2008.  The television tower in East Berlin is in the left background.
